title: ChampionKV: Head-Wise Adaptive Budget Allocation for KV Cache Compression
summary: ChampionKV replaces the uniform or predefined per-head budget allocation in observation-window KV compressors (SnapKV, PyramidKV) with input-adaptive head-wise budgets derived from attention concentration, leaving the token-selection procedure unchanged. The cost is negligible compute overhead for computing aggregated observation-window attention scores, plus an abnormal-head mask and floor-budget mechanism, with no additional memory beyond the compressed cache itself. It can fail to deliver gains on 7B/8B-class models, where results are mixed, and it does not uniformly outperform Ada-KV's global cross-head Top-K selection, so the base compressor choice may dominate the improvement.
rationale: It is a low-overhead plug-in the reader can run on a single 24 GB GPU, but the abstract reports statistically significant gains only on a 70B model and mixed results at the 7B/8B scale the reader is likely to deploy, so workload-specific validation is required before adoption.
technique: Head-wise adaptive KV cache budget allocation

claims.statement: ChampionKV replaces the uniform or predefined per-head budget allocation in observation-window KV compressors (SnapKV, PyramidKV) with input-adaptive head-wise budgets derived from attention concentration, leaving the token-selection procedure unchanged. The cost is negligible compute overhead for computing aggregated observation-window attention scores, plus an abnormal-head mask and floor-budget mechanism, with no additional memory beyond the compressed cache itself. It can fail to deliver gains on 7B/8B-class models, where results are mixed, and it does not uniformly outperform Ada-KV's global cross-head Top-K selection, so the base compressor choice may dominate the improvement.

On LongBench and RULER, ChampionKV variants consistently improve over SnapKV and PyramidKV base compressors, with the largest and statistically significant gains on Llama3.1-70B-Instruct under tight budgets; results on 7B/8B models are competitive but mixed, and Ada-KV retains an advantage in several settings.
